channel.title: The Christian Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Most Americans approve of Supreme Court decisions on parental rights, religious liberty
item.description: A new report reveals that most Americans support a recent United States Supreme Court decision allowing religious parents to opt their children out of LGBT-related curriculum as support for religious freedom as a whole reaches a record high. #SupremeCourt #MahmoudvTaylor #Becket #religiousliberty #parentalrights

item.title: Syria ceasefire raises hopes for stability but concerns for Christians, minorities remain
item.description: Syria has announced an immediate nationwide ceasefire with the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF), ending nearly two weeks of clashes, even as Christians and other minorities remain concerned that the agreement does little to ease fears of continued persecution and instability. #Syria #Kurds #Christian #SDF

item.title: NY Gov. Kathy Hochul says ICE is making people afraid to attend church in MLK Day speech
item.description: Democratic New York Gov. Kathy Hochul criticized the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement on Sunday during a worship service honoring the life of slain American civil rights activist and Baptist Rev. Martin Luther King Jr., claiming the agency is making people afraid to go to church. #ICE #KathyHochul #Governor #NewYork #Church #Immigration #ReneeGood

item.title: Do you know these 11 facts about Noah’s Ark?
item.description: The story of Noah’s Ark is one of the most well-known Bible stories and has been retold in songs, children’s storybooks, cartoons and films. #NoahsArk #Genesis #Biblefacts #Biblequiz

item.title: James Talarico says 'America isn't a Christian nation,' but admits founding documents 'profoundly Christian'
item.description: A Texas state lawmaker and U.S. Senate hopeful says, despite the nation's founding documents being based on the “radical teachings of Jesus,” the United States is “not a Christian nation.” #Texas #ChristianNationalism #JamesTalarico

item.title: How Martin Luther King Jr. Day became a federal holiday
item.description: Here are some of the steps that led to the creation of the federal Martin Luther King Jr. holiday, as well as some of the resistance to the effort. #MartinLutherKing #holiday #MLKDay #history #Conyers #Reagan #Helms #Congress

item.title: After years of chronic illness, Trip Lee releases worship music that makes room for lament (exclusive)
item.description: Pastor and artist Trip Lee shares how a keen understanding of lament and physical struggles influenced his latest project, a worship album titled " For Your Glory." #TripLee #ForYourGlory #worshipmusic #worshipalbum

item.title: Baku’s release of Armenian prisoners framed as progress in peace talks
item.description: Azerbaijan has released four Armenian prisoners in a development that officials in Yerevan described as a significant step in peace efforts between the two countries. The men were handed over at the Khakari Bridge and are now in Armenian territory, though some groups called it an “incomplete exchange.” #Azerbaijan #NagornoKarabakh #Artsakh #ReleaseofArmenianPrisoners #Baku #PeaceTalks #KhakariBridge #TRIPP #Syria #Jihadists

item.title: 'Shameful': Pastors, Christian leaders react to activists storming So. Baptist church in Minnesota
item.description: Pastors and other ministry leaders have roundly condemned a group of activists in Minnesota who disrupted a Sunday service at a Southern Baptist church in St. Paul, where a local official with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement allegedly serves as a pastor. #CitiesChurch #Minnesota #ICE #SouthernBaptist

item.title: MLK's niece says Don Lemon, ICE protesters should remember uncle's calls to protest peacefully
item.description: Alveda King, an evangelist and niece of the late Rev. Martin Luther King Jr., told The Christian Post that her uncle's legacy was founded on the biblical principle of servant leadership and that he would call for unity if he were alive today. #AlvedaKing #MartinLutherKingJr #DonLemon #ICE #Minnesota
